settings.title: Wiki Boards
settings.description: Choose which boards are used as a wiki, and which post is each board's front page.
settings.notice: On a wiki board the post title is the document name, so a title cannot be used twice. [[Document]] markup in a post body becomes a link to that document.
settings.notice_html: Bodies must be written in HTML mode (the rich editor) for links to appear. In plain-text mode the markup stays as literal characters.
settings.front_post_placeholder: Leave empty for no front page
settings.front_post_hint: The [[#최근수정]], [[#랜덤]] and [[#색인]] placeholders are only filled in on the front page post.
settings.save_error: Could not save the wiki board settings.

setup.needs_setup_body: No wiki board has been set up by this plugin yet. Create a new board below, or pick an empty board to turn into a wiki; the front page, index and syntax help documents are created along with it.
setup.mode_convert: Turn an existing board into a wiki
setup.name: Board name
setup.slug_hint: Start with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, up to 50 characters. The wiki lives at /board/{slug}.
setup.board: Board to turn into a wiki
setup.no_convertible: No board can be turned into a wiki. Only basic boards with no posts and no categories qualify.
setup.author: Seed document author
setup.author_hint: Chosen from users with the administrator role.
setup.error_title: Could not set up the wiki board
setup.release_body_1: The board and its posts are not deleted; they remain as ordinary board posts.
setup.release_body_2: [[link]] markup in documents will show as plain text.
setup.release_body_3: The search engine view may show the previous page for up to two hours.
setup.note_home_widgets: Seed documents may appear in the home page widgets' recent posts. To hide them, exclude this board in the home widgets settings (g7-home-widgets).
setup.note_menu: Right after setup, the wiki is reachable only by its address (/board/{slug}). Add it to the site menu yourself.
setup.note_uninstall: The plugin cannot be uninstalled while any wiki board set up here remains. Release it first; the board and its posts stay.
